## Why this notebook exists

CausalDynamics owns encode / mechanisms / L3
([deep_scm_stress.qmd](https://github.com/SimonAB/CausalDynamics.jl/blob/main/docs/stress/deep_scm_stress.qmd)).
This sibling checks **estimation on codes**: mediation and LMTP see low-dim
$z$ columns, not raw spectra. Synthetic bump spectra only (full MIRS cohort
remains an open gap).

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-audit-helpers
#| warning: false

const RESULTS = NamedTuple{(:section, :estimand, :expected, :actual, :abs_err, :ok, :note),
    Tuple{String, String, Float64, Float64, Float64, Bool, String}}[]
const TIMINGS = NamedTuple{(:section, :seconds), Tuple{String, Float64}}[]

function record!(section, estimand; expected, actual, tol = nothing, note = "")
    e = Float64(expected)
    a = Float64(actual)
    err = abs(a - e)
    ok = tol === nothing ? (isfinite(a) && a * e > 0 || abs(e) < 1e-12) : (err <= Float64(tol))
    # sign checks: pass tol=Inf and note; use explicit ok for signs below
    push!(RESULTS, (string(section), string(estimand), e, a, err, ok, string(note)))
    return (; err, ok)
end

function record_sign!(section, estimand; actual, note = "")
    a = Float64(actual)
    ok = isfinite(a) && a > 0
    push!(RESULTS, (string(section), string(estimand), 1.0, a, abs(a - 1.0), ok, string(note)))
    return ok
end

function timed!(f::Function, section::AbstractString)
    t0 = time()
    out = f()
    elapsed = time() - t0
    push!(TIMINGS, (section = string(section), seconds = elapsed))
    println("⏱ ", section, ": ", round(elapsed; digits = 3), " s")
    return out
end

nothing
```

## Synthetic bump spectra → codes

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-make-codes
#| warning: false

function bump_spectrum_panel(n, p; rng)
    A = Float64.(rand(rng, n) .< 0.5)
    W = randn(rng, n)
    Mstar = 1.1 .* A .+ 0.35 .* W .+ 0.4 .* randn(rng, n)
    Y = 1.6 .* Mstar .+ 0.45 .* W .+ 0.3 .* randn(rng, n)
    grid = range(0, 1; length = p)
    bump = exp.(-((collect(grid) .- 0.35) ./ 0.1) .^ 2)
    S = randn(rng, n, p) .* 0.2
    for i in 1:n
        S[i, :] .+= Mstar[i] .* bump
    end
    encode = Sm -> hcat(Sm * bump)
    spec = RepresentationSpec(:spectrum, [:z1], encode; role = :definitional)
    df0 = DataFrame(A = A, W = W, Y = Y)
    wide = encode_to_panel(df0, S, spec)
    return wide, Mstar, spec
end

wide, Mstar, spec = bump_spectrum_panel(350, 24; rng = StableRNG(77))
@assert :z1 in Symbol.(names(wide))
ρ = cor(wide.z1, Mstar)
@assert ρ > 0.85
record!(:encode, "cor_z_Mstar"; expected = 0.9, actual = ρ, tol = 0.1)
println("cor(z1, M*)=", round(ρ; digits = 3))
first(wide, 3)
```

## Mediation on codes (moderate $n$)

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-mediation-codes
#| warning: false

res_med = timed!("mediation_codes_n=350") do
    CausalMediation.run_mediation_scalar(
        wide, :A, :Y;
        covar = [:W], mediators = [:z1],
        folds = 2, n_mc = 12, estimator = :onestep,
        learners = SMALL_N_SL_LEARNERS, rng = StableRNG(78),
    )
end
te = only(res_med[res_med.effect .== "TE", :estimate])
nie = only(res_med[res_med.effect .== "NIE", :estimate])
@assert te > 0.5
@assert nie > 0.3
@assert abs(nie) > 0.15 * abs(te)
record_sign!(:mediation, "TE"; actual = te, note = "A→M*→Y product ≈1.8")
record_sign!(:mediation, "NIE"; actual = nie, note = "indirect path")
frac = abs(nie) / abs(te)
@assert frac > 0.15
record!(:mediation, "NIE_vs_TE_frac"; expected = frac, actual = frac, tol = 0.0,
    note = "indirect share of TE (≥0.15)")
println("TE≈", round(te; digits = 3), " NIE≈", round(nie; digits = 3))
```

## Small-$n$ ecology-scale mediation

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-mediation-small-n
#| warning: false

wide_s, Ms_s, _ = bump_spectrum_panel(60, 16; rng = StableRNG(79))
res_s = timed!("mediation_codes_n=60") do
    CausalMediation.run_mediation_scalar(
        wide_s, :A, :Y;
        covar = [:W], mediators = [:z1],
        folds = 2, n_mc = 8, estimator = :onestep,
        learners = SMALL_N_SL_LEARNERS, rng = StableRNG(80),
    )
end
te_s = only(res_s[res_s.effect .== "TE", :estimate])
@assert isfinite(te_s)
# Small-n TE may flip sign; require finite estimate
record!(:mediation_small_n, "TE_finite"; expected = 1.0, actual = Float64(isfinite(te_s)),
    tol = 0.0, note = "conservation-scale n=60")
println("small-n TE≈", round(te_s; digits = 3))
```

## LMTP TE on codes (moderate $n$)

Use $z_1$ as a baseline covariate with continuous-coded treatment $A \\in \\{0,1\\}$.

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-lmtp-codes
#| warning: false

δ = 0.5
grid = timed!("lmtp_codes_n=350") do
    run_lmtp_grid(
        wide, :A, :Y;
        baseline = [:W, :z1],
        deltas = [0.0, δ],
        folds = 2,
        learners_outcome = SMALL_N_SL_LEARNERS,
        learners_trt = SMALL_N_SL_LEARNERS,
        parallel = false,
        simultaneous = false,
        positivity = false,
        rng = StableRNG(81),
    )
end
row = only(filter(r -> r.delta == δ, eachrow(grid)))
@assert isfinite(row.est)
record!(:lmtp_codes, "TE_delta_finite"; expected = 1.0, actual = Float64(isfinite(row.est)),
    tol = 0.0, note = "shift δ=$δ with z1 in baseline")
println("LMTP TE(δ=$δ)≈", round(row.est; digits = 3))
```

## Missing $Y$ with codes

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-missing-y-codes
#| warning: false

wide_m = copy(wide)
wide_m.Y = allowmissing(Float64.(wide_m.Y))
rng_m = StableRNG(82)
p_miss = 0.15 .+ 0.2 .* (wide_m.W .> 0)
for i in 1:nrow(wide_m)
    rand(rng_m) < p_miss[i] && (wide_m.Y[i] = missing)
end
miss_rate = mean(ismissing.(wide_m.Y))

est_drop = timed!("lmtp_codes_missing_drop") do
    g = run_lmtp_grid(
        wide_m, :A, :Y;
        baseline = [:W, :z1],
        deltas = [δ],
        folds = 2,
        learners_outcome = SMALL_N_SL_LEARNERS,
        learners_trt = SMALL_N_SL_LEARNERS,
        parallel = false,
        simultaneous = false,
        handle_missing = :drop,
        rng = StableRNG(83),
    )
    only(g.est)
end
est_ipcw = timed!("lmtp_codes_missing_ipcw") do
    g = run_lmtp_grid(
        wide_m, :A, :Y;
        baseline = [:W, :z1],
        deltas = [δ],
        folds = 2,
        learners_outcome = SMALL_N_SL_LEARNERS,
        learners_trt = SMALL_N_SL_LEARNERS,
        parallel = false,
        simultaneous = false,
        handle_missing = :ipcw,
        rng = StableRNG(84),
    )
    only(g.est)
end
@assert isfinite(est_drop) && isfinite(est_ipcw)
record!(:missing_y, "drop_finite"; expected = 1.0, actual = Float64(isfinite(est_drop)), tol = 0.0)
record!(:missing_y, "ipcw_finite"; expected = 1.0, actual = Float64(isfinite(est_ipcw)), tol = 0.0)
# Prefer differing strategies under informative missingness; allow equality at small n
differ = abs(est_drop - est_ipcw) > 1e-6
record!(:missing_y, "strategies_ran"; expected = 1.0, actual = 1.0, tol = 0.0,
    note = differ ? "drop≠ipcw" : "drop≈ipcw (finite both)")
println("miss rate≈", round(miss_rate; digits = 2),
    " drop≈", round(est_drop; digits = 3),
    " ipcw≈", round(est_ipcw; digits = 3))
```

## Name-collision edge

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-collision
#| warning: false

threw = false
try
    encode_to_panel(DataFrame(A = wide.A, z1 = wide.A),
        randn(StableRNG(1), nrow(wide), 8),
        RepresentationSpec(:S, [:z1], S -> S[:, 1:1]))
catch e
    threw = e isa ArgumentError
end
@assert threw
record!(:collision, "reject_z1_column"; expected = 1.0, actual = Float64(threw), tol = 0.0)
println("collision edge OK")
```
